purpose: The managed environment the Earth2Studio doors (tc-tracks, earth2-diagnose, earth2) run their runners in, and the TempestExtremes executables tc-tracks --backend tempestextremes calls. Built by `gpuwm setup --with-earth2`, or on first use by a door that needs it. The earth2studio version and the per-CUDA install commands are runtime.pinned_version and runtime.install_recipes of earth2-models.v1.json; this table adds only what the managed build needs beyond them.

location.interpreter_override: GPUWM_EARTH2_PYTHON names an interpreter to use as is; the managed environment is then neither used nor changed
location.first_use_fetch: GPUWM_EARTH2_FETCH=0 stops a door from building the managed environment on first use; it then refuses with the remedy instead

cu12.reason: earth2studio 0.19.0's [cyclone] extra names the CUDA 13 wheels (cupy-cuda13x, cucim-cu13), which do not load on a CUDA 12 driver; on cu12 the same packages are installed for that major. fcn3: see cu13

cu13.reason: earth2studio 0.19.0's [fcn3] extra names makani, which is not on PyPI (earth2studio's own [tool.uv.sources] takes makani and torch-harmonics from these git revisions), so a wheel install of earth2studio[fcn3] cannot resolve it and the managed environment had no torch_harmonics or makani: every FCN3 run there died at model import (2.9.4 landing, 2026-10-20). The same packages are installed from earth2studio 0.19.0's pinned revisions; torch-harmonics is BSD-3-Clause, makani Apache-2.0, built with --no-build-isolation as the recipe installs earth2studio

uv_bootstrap.note: Used from PATH when present; otherwise installed with this interpreter's pip into <env>/.uv
